session.failed: The application session is unavailable (HTTP {status}). Reopen the application from fnOS or try again.
session.network: Cannot reach the NAS. Check the connection and try again.
session.timeout: The request timed out. Its result may be unknown; check the current state before submitting again.
session.invalid: The application session response is invalid. Reopen the application from fnOS.

camera.title: Scan an authenticator QR code
camera.idle: Start the camera to request permission, or choose a photo.
camera.scanning: Point the camera at an authenticator QR code.
camera.validating: Checking the account with the NAS…
camera.paused: Camera stopped. Start it again when ready.
camera.picker: If the camera did not open, take a photo using your phone and choose the image here.
camera.photoHelp: For a QR code on this screen, take a screenshot and choose that image. The device controls the photo picker.
camera.insecure: Live camera access needs a secure browser context. Use HTTPS, or choose a photo or image.
camera.unsupported: This window does not provide camera access. Choose a photo or image, or use a supported HTTPS browser.
camera.denied: Camera access was denied by the browser, system, or application window. Check its permissions, then try again.
camera.missing: No camera was found. Connect a camera or choose an image.
camera.busy: The camera is unavailable or in use by another application. Try again or choose an image.
camera.constraints: This camera cannot use the selected settings. Try the default camera.
camera.permissionTimeout: The camera request did not finish. You can try again or choose a photo or image.
camera.playbackTimeout: The camera preview did not start. Try again or choose an image.
camera.decodeTimeout: Image recognition timed out. Crop the image around the QR code and try again.
camera.decoder: The local QR reader could not start. Reload the application or enter the account manually.
camera.imageTooLarge: The image is too large. Crop it around the QR code or choose a screenshot.
camera.imageUnsupported: This image cannot be read. Choose PNG, JPEG, or WebP, or take a screenshot.
camera.notFound: No QR code was found. Choose a clear image or crop it around the code.
camera.invalid: The QR code is not a valid authenticator account or migration code.
camera.unknown: The camera could not start. Try again, choose an image, or enter the account manually.

backup.title: Encrypted backup
backup.description: Export an encrypted backup of your OTP accounts, or preview one before importing. Groups, icons and preferences are not included.
backup.passphraseHelp: Use 10 to 1024 characters. Keep this passphrase safe; it is required to restore the backup.
backup.expires: This preview expires in five minutes. Review the accounts before confirming.
backup.exported: The encrypted backup download is ready.
backup.passphraseInvalid: Enter a passphrase between 10 and 1024 characters.
backup.fileInvalid: Choose an encrypted backup no larger than 8 MiB.
backup.backup_invalid_request: The backup request is invalid. Check the selected file and passphrase.
backup.decryption_failed: The backup could not be decrypted. Check the passphrase and file.
backup.preview_expired: The preview has expired. Preview the backup again before importing.
backup.preview_conflict: The vault changed after this preview. Preview the backup again.
backup.backup_unavailable: Backup processing is currently unavailable. Try again later.
backup.session_required: The NAS session is no longer valid. Reload the application to sign in again.
backup.failed: The backup operation failed. Check the vault before repeating an import.
